poll_interval_ms.label: Refresh Interval (ms)
poll_interval_ms.description: How often TachoPulse polls hardware sensors and redraws graphs (500–10000 ms).

bar_gauge_size.label: Bar Graph Size (px)
bar_gauge_size.description: Pixel size for status bar graphs. Sizes < 52px use a high-contrast compact ring; sizes >= 52px render a full 3-line inner tachometer.

desktop_gauge_size.label: Desktop Graph Size (px)
desktop_gauge_size.description: Pixel size for full-sized desktop widget tachometers, bars, and histograms (56–160 px).

desktop_columns.label: Desktop Grid Columns
desktop_columns.description: Number of sensor cards per row in the Desktop Widget.

respect_gpu_sleep.label: Respect Discrete GPU Sleep
respect_gpu_sleep.description: Avoid waking suspended discrete GPUs when polling.
